svg.title: Compressed files: Warden against nginx
svg.desc: Two bar charts of server CPU per request when the client asks for gzip, Warden against nginx 1.24. 20 KB stylesheet: Warden 12.56 microseconds, nginx gzip_static 14.16, nginx gzip on level 1 94.05, level 6 345.99. 100 KB script: Warden 13.72, gzip_static 12.50, gzip on level 1 627.36, level 6 2,430.30. Warden uses 7 to 177 times less CPU than nginx compressing on the fly; against gzip_static it is level, 11 percent less at 20 KB and 10 percent more at 100 KB.

svg.text: Warden: default configuration, compress on, the copy already made. The first request for a file is sent as it is.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gzip_static serves a .gz made at build time; gzip on compresses on every request.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Warden also makes brotli (2,830 bytes for the 20 KB file); the nginx package tested has no brotli module.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
